current_ned_sia_probe.note: Westmeier et al. 2013 documents having retrieved the original reduced Puche VLA cube from NED, but the current exact NED SIA target+refcode query returns zero records.

later_public_routes.Westmeier_2013: Publishes major-axis and minor-axis H I column-density cuts rather than the required axisymmetric radial surface-density profile.
later_public_routes.LVHIS_2018: Publishes NGC55 global H I checks including F_HI=2025.4 Jy km/s and R_HI=1106 arcsec, but no exact machine-readable radial H I series was recovered in this acquisition pass.

reopen_rule: Reopen for a restored Puche1991 NED cube, public LVHIS/Westmeier science-ready FITS product suitable for a predeclared warped-disc reconstruction, or an exact machine-readable axisymmetric radial H I profile.
boundary: No raster digitization, profile fitting, persistence fitting, or blind-outcome inspection. L_A and C_A remain locked.
